title: polypodium neurodioides
intro: Polypodium neurodioides, commonly known as Chinese Polypodium, is a type of fern native to China. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Polypodium are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects, which are being studied further for their medicinal applications.
